name: Sertraline
summary: Sertraline is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) antidepressant.
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Initial N-demethylation forms less active N-desmethylsertraline. Further deamination, reduction, hydroxylation and glucuronidation precede elimination in urine and feces. Multiple enzymes participate; the reviewed label does not identify one exclusive CYP pathway.
